Sunty Bhai Channel:-
Second Channel:-
An entire American town with just ONE resident! On Day 3 of our USA campervan road trip, Sunty Bhai and I visit Monowi, Nebraska, and explore a side of America far away from its big cities.
Travelling in Sunty Bhai’s self-built Mercedes campervan, our journey takes us through Oklahoma, Kansas and Nebraska, before we finally enter South Dakota. Along the way, we stop in Wichita, Kansas, to visit the world’s first Pizza Hut, the little building where it all began!
